title: LLM pointer response (inner loop)
description: Shape emitted by the LLM during inner-loop pointer planning. Contains only file/id or file/jq_path pointers — no entry content.

pointers.description: Validated pointer references. Each item identifies an entry by file+id or file+jq_path. No content field is permitted.

unresolved.description: Pointers that could not be resolved after inner-loop iterations. Must be non-empty if any miss occurred; silent drops are forbidden.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the pointer could not be resolved.

pointer_item.description: A single pointer reference. Must contain 'file' plus exactly one of 'id' or 'jq_path'. No 'content' field is permitted.

file.description: Path to the spec file, relative to git-root.

id.description: Entry-level id lookup (most common). Mutually exclusive with jq_path.

jq_path.description: Sub-field jq-path lookup. Mutually exclusive with id.
